description:
Search short-form videos (YouTube Shorts and similar) for a query.

Operations (set "operation" to one of these; put its parameters in "args"):
- search (required: query): Search Shorts

args.description: Parameters for the chosen operation as key/value pairs (see the tool description for required params).

operation.description: Which endpoint to call. See the tool description for each operation and its parameters.
